summary: iptables options: numeric to skip DNS lookups if listing hangs, out_interface, and policy to set a built-in chain's default target, which ignores other parameters.
questions: How do I set the default policy of the INPUT chain?
Why does iptables hang when creating a chain or setting policy?
How do I match outgoing traffic by interface?

answer_card.title: iptables policy, numeric, out_interface
answer_card.answer_md:
- `policy`: `ACCEPT`, `DROP`, `QUEUE`, `RETURN` for a built-in `chain`; ignores all other params (not the same as `jump`)
- `numeric` (false): skip DNS in internal listing if iptables hangs
- `out_interface`: FORWARD/OUTPUT/POSTROUTING; `+` wildcard, `!` negation
